It is a small raw fish restaurant near Jamsil Saenae Station. Seeing that there are a lot of reservation customers, it seems like there are a lot of regulars. If you go around 6-7pm without a reservation, there will be almost no seats. I visited twice between 7 and 9 o'clock, and once it was full, and once I was lucky enough to find only one empty seat.
Porridge, odeng soup, kimchi pancake, conches, water dumplings, grilled saury, vegetables, and spicy fish stew are provided as standard. The special feature of this restaurant is the fresh radish put on the bottom of the raw fish and the generous amount of perilla leaves and ssamjang that come with it. Place radish greens on perilla leaves and eat them together with a piece of raw fish coated with ssamjang. The sweetness of the radish combines well with the salty ssamjang and light raw fish to make it taste quite good.  One thing that is a bit disappointing is that the amount of meetings seems a bit small. It is worth making a reservation in advance and visiting once.

reviews.text:
After eating something like cake in the morning, I somehow thought of spicy cold noodles in the evening. I wanted to go to the famous Honggane Naengmyeon in Yeongcheon Market in Seodaemun-gu, which I enjoyed visiting recently, or Grandma Naengmyeon in Dongdaemun-gu, which suited me best among the cold noodle restaurants famous for spicy cold noodles, but I had to go to Suseo, but it was completely opposite, so the route was bad, so I decided to stop by Haeju Naengmyeon, another spicy cold noodle restaurant I visited last time.

I didn't want to make a fuss, so I called, but the signal was working, but only a business hours announcement was made and I couldn't make a call. I thought it must be too busy since I saw it was crowded with customers during my first visit, so I went to Suseo and stopped by.

As I approached the front of the store, it felt dark and strong. When I got to the store, the lights were off so I wondered if it was a holiday, but there was a winter holiday notice posted. Wow... this is the first time I've heard of winter vacation at a store even though it's not school.

We had no choice but to stop by the nearby Yellow Whole Chicken, which we had prepared as a backup list just in case because our young family member wanted to eat chicken.

Since it was nearby, I arrived quickly and it seemed like this neighborhood has been a food alley for a long time, so there are quite a lot of customers and business is going well.

If it's not the old brand chicken such as KFC Original Chicken, Lim's Chicken, or Duduul Chicken, I like the fried chicken with the curry scent of the yellow whole chicken among modern brands. I especially like the 3-type set consisting of the representative menu, fried, seasoned, and kanpung chicken, and the kanpung chicken, which is spicy and dry-fried as the name of the menu suggests instead of using sticky seasoning, is also a menu that is different from other chicken restaurants.

If I were going to eat it, I would order half-fried and half-fried kkanpung, but my young family likes seasoning, so I ordered half-fried and half-seasoned.

After waiting for a while, the food was packaged and handed to me. When I looked inside, the Sincheon branch seemed to be packaged more systematically, perhaps because it was located in a neighborhood with a lot of traffic, and it felt like it was packaged by a larger franchise such as KFC.

When I got home and unpacked it, there were a lot of things inside the packaging bag, such as seasoning sauce, sesame salt, a menu, a 1,000 won coupon, a gargle pouch, etc. The fried food was in a paper bag as always, and the seasoning was in a typical chicken box covered with aluminum foil.

I don't like sticky, sweet seasoned chicken, so I only tasted one, and when I tasted it with a little sesame salt that came with the fried chicken, I liked the salty, subtle curry flavor.

However, because it is boneless chicken, each piece is relatively small, so it feels like a chicken strip, so it is easy to eat, but compared to chicken with bones, it is disappointing that you cannot expect the juice or anything like that, so it feels like you sacrificed the juice for the inconvenience of putting the bone on. It was an inevitable choice for a young family, and although it is not chicken, it is nice to be able to eat more of the crispy batter as each piece is small.

Overall, among the numerous chicken brands, it has its own differentiation and tastes good. When I eat with family who don't like my favorite KFC or old brand chicken, I think I will continue to use the yellow whole chicken here, which I can compromise on, as I like it much more than the chickens like BHC Purinkle, which taste like shit to me.

Q. Then if you do it separately, it will cost 28,500 won. If you add whipped cream now, it will cost 30,500 won. Lettering is 2,000-3,000 won cheaper.

>>> Now that I think about it, they had painted already the outside purple before even showing the cake, so I don't know if they were making strange noises.

The location is good and the workers are very friendly, but the interior is not large, so please think of it as just sitting for a while before visiting.
It's too small ㅠㅠ

But the cake is still delicious.
I also recommend snacks!! It was cooked well and crispy.

reviews.author: JJANGA K
reviews.text: The cake is soft and has natural sweetness rather than artificial sweetness! Recommended~!!

reviews.author: June
reviews.text:
It was my first time visiting and there was a new menu item called Mont Blanc cake, so I tried it and was disappointed. Although there are whole chestnuts in the cake, the chestnut flavor is less noticeable in the chestnut cream and feels like it is playing separately from the cake. The price is expensive too
It was very different from the Mont Blanc cake I had in Japan.

reviews.text: 31 flavors... But it's a place where you mainly eat Korean food...

reviews.author: Kc Lee
reviews.text: There is a kiosk, so two part-time workers are waiting without taking orders. Honestly, kiosks are complicated and time consuming. We go to the first branch in Sincheon where orders are taken directly. I think the boss should know.

reviews.author: Jiho Park
reviews.text: I took off 1 star because the store is small and you have to order through a kiosk. The menu is reasonably diverse and the store is small.

reviews.author: Eunkyung Lee
reviews.text: The ice cream shop ran out of milk. Was it the Jolly Pong Shake? I couldn't drink the drink of the month, but the Jolly Pong ice cream was delicious... A place I can't pass by when I go to Aladdin... Please take good care of the milk stock!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I'll go buy it again.

address: 1st floor, 120 Olympic-ro, Songpa-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Lee Je-hyuk
reviews.text:
I was curious about the new ice cream shop, so I stopped by. (Vera has been nearby for a long time...)
There are many different types of ice cream, and the store is clean. Is it because it's new? Hahaha
It's a bit expensive, but the taste is very rich and great.
The sundae is made right in front of you, and it's fun to watch it being made, and the kids love it too.
This is a delicious and fun ice cream shop.
